items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Joe Rene, Joe Rene come up to be a drummer way after Rene started playing out, you know?

ctx.x: What about Joe Rene? Was he in there? Who was that? Joe Rene. Kid ran in.

No, he wasn't in there. Joe Rene, Joe Rene come up to be a drummer way after Rene started playing out, you know? Mm-hmm. And then he played clarinet, learned clarinet, you know? But that was weird. Ran in there, been in the homes, learned how to play and come out and play it around a good while before him and Joe got together. Mm-hmm.
I see. So there must have been a pretty good band. How big a band was it? At that time?
